title: Chromagentic theme settings
description: Settings for `chromagentic generate`. Only `colors` is required; everything else has a sensible default.

cssColor.description: Any CSS color, for example "#0265dc" or "oklch(60% 0.2 250)".

interpolation.description: How to blend between key colors. Default "oklch".

contrast.description: WCAG 2 ratio (1 to 21) or, with the apca formula, an Lc value (up to 108).

colors.description: Named color scales. Each is one key color, a list of key colors (from light to dark, or any order), or an object with keys and interpolation. A scale with no chroma becomes the neutral (gray) scale.

color.description: Name of the scale that tints backgrounds and surfaces. Default: the neutral scale.

lightness.description: Default background lightness (0 = black, 1 = white) for modes that don't set their own.

steps.description: Contrast targets for each scale step against the background. A list is named 100, 200, 300 and so on. Default: 16 steps from 100 to 1600.

opposite.description: WCAG 2 only: the exact ratio to use on the opposite background (for example dark mode), instead of polarity compensation.

surfaces.description: Layered surfaces such as cards and menus. Default: raised (1.1:1 from its parent) and floating (1.6:1 from the base background).

contrast.description: WCAG 2 ratio from the reference surface (always a WCAG ratio, even with APCA).

reference.description: Measure from the base background or the previous surface. Default "parent".

color.description: Scale name that tints this surface. Default: the background scale.

roles.description: Named roles that point to a scale step ("gray.1400") or a surface ("surface.raised"). Use null to remove a default role.

status.description: Status roles and the scale or CSS color for each. Default: success green, warning orange, error red, info blue. Use false for none.

modes.description: Each mode is built from global settings. Default: light (background lightness 1) and dark (0.08).

contrastMultiplier.description: 1 = unchanged, above 1 = more contrast (for example 1.5 for high contrast), below 1 = less.

polarityCompensation.description: Extra contrast on dark backgrounds (WCAG 2 only). 0.1 = 10%.

media.description: CSS media query that turns the mode on, or false for none. Worked out from the mode name when left out.

defaultMode.description: Mode used when nothing else applies. Default: the first mode.

polarityCompensation.description: Default polarity compensation for every mode. Default 0.1 (10%).

gamut.description: Largest gamut colors may use. Default "rec2020" (wide gamut).

format.description: How CSS strings are written. Default "oklch".
